# Required by the full-run ingest oracle (``source_facts.semantic``).
semantic_authority = true
# The switch that makes this stage necessary.  Golden-fixture suppression is
# the ONLY producer channel that fills ``findings.groups.clones.suppressed``,
# and no wire-freeze stage declared it — so the suppressed population was
# absent everywhere and F8's exclusion of it could never fire.
golden_fixture_paths = ["tests/fixtures/golden"]
